score_scale.2: Partial capability with meaningful production/evidence gaps
score_scale.3: Credible capability but not category-leading evidence
score_scale.4: Strong mature capability with substantial public/internal evidence
score_scale.5: Category-leading or unusually strong evidence for this dimension

status_rule.RECOVERYOS_ADVANTAGE_EVIDENCED: RecoveryOS score exceeds competitor by at least 2 points.
status_rule.ROUGH_PARITY_OR_UNCLEAR: Scores differ by no more than 1 point.
status_rule.COMPETITOR_ADVANTAGE_EVIDENCED: Competitor score exceeds RecoveryOS by at least 2 points.

methodology.caveat: Scores are evidence-weighted engineering judgments, not audited market-share rankings. Vendor public claims remain vendor claims.

second_look_attribution.rationale: Frozen incumbent universe, explicit challenger-only/incumbent-known/suppressed/review states, duplicate-economic-key review, and net-new candidate accounting are implemented and regression tested.

evidence_provenance.rationale: Canonical hashes, source lineage, immutable evidence tables, audit-chain verification, payment event chaining, and explicit separation of candidate/confirmed/settled/reversed value are implemented.

audit_rating_breadth.rationale: Six declared modes are deterministically rated, but rule families are intentionally narrower than mature FAP vendors' hundreds of audit checks and negotiated-rule libraries.

real_world_accuracy.rationale: 42-scenario frozen synthetic gold set is exact, but blind independently adjudicated customer accuracy remains pending.

ingestion_extraction.rationale: Canonical API, SFTP manifest, X12 parser/projection and guarded formats exist, but no production OCR/document extraction pipeline is evidenced.

enterprise_integrations.rationale: API/SFTP/X12 building blocks exist; named production ERP/TMS/accounting connectors and broad enterprise onboarding evidence do not.

payment_execution.rationale: PaymentOS rigorously orchestrates and proves lifecycle state but does not own or directly provide bank/ACH/wire/custody rails.

analytics_ux.rationale: Authenticated reviewer cockpit, payment queue, tenant-scoped analytics and governed natural-language analytics are live, but reporting breadth is smaller than mature enterprise suites.

security_assurance.rationale: Strong internal controls and evidence package exist; SOC 2 Type II, ISO 27001, independent pen test, provider encryption and provider backup/restore attestations remain pending.

identity_access.rationale: Roles, secure sessions, strong password policy, scoped API keys and same-origin controls exist; MFA and enterprise SSO remain unproven.

claim_boundary: This matrix compares currently evidenced capabilities, not secret roadmap items.
Competitor scores rely on first-party vendor claims and are not independent audits.
A missing public competitor claim does not prove the competitor lacks a capability.
RecoveryOS is not classified as overall #1 until evidence closes the listed gaps.
